subject: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Hill <grace@talentbridge.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions

Hi team,

We're at the point this week where we need to finalize offers for three senior hires in Q2 and I want to make sure we align on prioritization and any comp-band exceptions before we push paperwork to candidates. Attached is a single workbook (HC_Q2_offers.xlsx) with the current offer mix and a short pdf (Comp_Band_Exception_Request_Mar15.pdf) summarizing the exception requests. TL;DR:

- SVP Engineering (REQ-4821): market comp pushes top-of-band + $40k sign-on to be competitive. HR recommends exception.
- VP Product: within band but needs accelerated start date clause tied to hiring bonus.
- Head of Data Platform: candidate willing to accept standard band but needs remote/location exception.

Action needed: please reply with approvals (approve / approve with modification / hold) and any conditions by EOD Wednesday so we can get offers out Thursday. If leadership wants to reprioritize, suggest which role you'd move to Q3 instead.

Grace — looped you for offer timing confirmation; Elliot (candidate) is on standby but asks for final number by Thursday morning.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
VP, Talent & Org Strategy
Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: HC_Q2_offers.xlsx (spreadsheet), Comp_Band_Exception_Request_Mar15.pdf (summary)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions

Stephanie — thanks for the concise packet. Quick notes:

- I'm sympathetic to making an exception for the SVP Eng given market data, but I'd like finance to confirm runway impact first. If the net burn delta is >$1.2m ARR-equivalent, we should consider swapping VP Product to Q3 instead.
- VP Product: agree accelerate but prefer a smaller hiring bonus and a performance milestone kicker (6-month OKR).
- Head of Data Platform: fine to proceed within band, but please confirm remote/location approval from Legal (we've had changes to EU payroll).

I can approve the SVP package conditional on finance check and a short note to the board about the exception. If finance signs off, greenlight from my side.

Marcus
CRO, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions

Folks — from HR comp perspective:

- The comp band for SVP Eng (Band E2) has been reviewed against market comp (benchmarking attached in the pdf). The requested top-of-band + sign-on is within the exception thresholds we discussed at last QBR. We recommend a formal exception route vs. permanent band change.:
  - Exception rationale: scarcity of senior infra leadership and multi-cloud inference scale experience.
  - Suggested guardrails: 12-month clawback on sign-on if voluntary departure < 12 months; performance milestone evaluation at 6 months.

- VP Product: can be done with smaller cash bonus + equity uplift instead of an oversized signing bonus; this reduces near-term cash impact.

- Head of Data Platform: legal confirmed remote arrangement is allowed with contractor-to-employee conversion in region; compensation stays in band.

If Leadership approves exception for SVP Eng with the guardrails above, HR will prepare offer paperwork and the comp exception memo for the exec summary.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Comp_Band_Exception_Request_Mar15.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions

Thanks all — quick decision here to keep momentum.

- Approve exception for SVP Engineering with the HR guardrails Laura proposed (clawback + 6-month review). I don't want us to lose this candidate and the revenue upside for the product roadmap is material.
- VP Product: approve with Marcus' modification (smaller cash, equity kicker tied to 6-mo OKRs).
- Head of Data Platform: proceed as-is.

Stephanie: please move forward with offer letters. Marcus — please confirm finance's runway check by EOD tomorrow; if finance flags, we will revisit.

Vivek
CEO, Redwood Inference
From: Grace Hill <grace@talentbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Elliot Shaw <elliot.shaw@candidate-mail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions

Stephanie, Team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Elliot is available for a final phone this afternoon if you want to confirm start dates and the sign-on structure verbally (he has two other processes moving). If you send the offer today with the agreed terms (top-of-band + $40k sign-on, clawback clause), he indicated 72-hour acceptance window but may accept earlier.

I can convert the verbal hold into a written soft offer pending formal docs. Please let me know preferred timing and any tweaks to bonus/equity split.

Grace Hill
Partner, TalentBridge
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Grace Hill <grace@talentbridge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior leadership offer pipeline prioritization and comp-band exceptions

Great — thanks everyone.

Plan of record:
1) Approve SVP Engineering exception and send offer today. Include 12-month clawback and 6-month milestone review.
2) VP Product: offer with reduced cash bonus + equity kicker; conditional on Marcus confirming finance runway by EOD tomorrow.
3) Head of Data Platform: standard offer, send Friday.

Grace — please send the soft offer agreement to Elliot ASAP and mark a 72-hour window. Laura/Legal — I'll follow up with Offer_Terms_SVP_ENG.docx for signature routing and will upload the comp-exception memo to the Drive folder (link above). Marcus — ping me once finance responds.

Stephanie
VP, Talent & Org Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Offer_Terms_SVP_ENG.docx (offer template)
